NotaTV

Code

Scan the QR code on the TV with the phone's camera (Settings → Network → Connect a phone). Then everything is sent encrypted. Or enter the phone page code (keys and text only - logins need the QR code):

Remote control

Power

Turn on: the TV turns on and switches to the box. A box that sleeps is woken with the remote - the phone cannot reach it.

Type text on the TV

Open a text field on the TV first (e.g. search or password).

Live TV (IPTV)

Xtream Codes login

YouTube subscriptions

Import your subscriptions: go to takeout.google.com, choose only "YouTube and YouTube Music" → "subscriptions", download and choose the file subscriptions.csv here. No login on the TV needed.

YouTube account (optional)

Sign in to youtube.com in your browser, export the cookies as cookies.txt (e.g. with the extension "Get cookies.txt LOCALLY") and choose the file here. Repeat for more accounts.

Network drive

Troubleshooting

The box's logs as one file, to send to whoever helps you. Passwords and logins are removed. For more details: turn on Settings → Advanced → Troubleshooting log on the TV, make the problem happen, then download.
